name: @levonis/svc-gateway
description: levonis-gateway — the only Worker with zone routes: host classification, origin check and security headers (the core's, byte-identical), signed-principal resolution, the capability table, layered rate limiting, request validation, the safe anonymous-GET cache, the Turnstile hook, correlation ids, health, and the routing table that forwards every legacy prefix to the core over a service binding with a kill-switch override.
